sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

No information is available on the clinical use of pamabrom during breastfeeding. If the mother requires pamabrom, it is not a reason to discontinue breastfeeding. Monitor the infant for excessive urination, adequate weight gain and skin rash.
